vdj_recombination.metaphor: In immunology, VDJ recombination uses RAG enzymes to cut and rejoin gene segments during cell division, creating antibody diversity. In Gaia, REBOOT is the RAG enzyme — it cuts the old configuration and DHCP reassembles the new one.

mechanism.trigger: REBOOT (or DHCP renewal, or sleep/wake cycle)
mechanism.cut: Old DNS config dies (192.168.4.244:53 only → empty answers for internet names)
mechanism.result: DNS demixing — internet queries go to Google/Cloudflare, local queries go to hickory-dns

inversion.before: Push fix TO northGate (manual, fragile, requires Kevin at keyboard)
inversion.after: northGate PULLS fix FROM Router on reboot (automatic, inevitable, sleep IS the fix)

persistence.gaia_web: user service + linger=yes — data server :8080 auto-starts

flint_eyes.thesis: Flint 1 and Flint 2 are the organism's EYES. When they reboot, they BLINK — and come back with new DNS vision. Stereoscopic: two eyes, two houses, one organism seeing.

eye_1.name: Flint 1 — Left Eye
eye_1.status: ALIVE but WDS bridge broken (apcli0/apclix0 disconnected)
eye_1.on_reboot: DHCP renews → gets 8.8.8.8+1.1.1.1+.244 → DNS vision restored → BLINK

eye_2.name: Flint 2 — Right Eye
eye_2.status: CONFIRMED via IPv6 — 5 SSIDs, 2 bands. WAN port SILENT (needs SSH fix)
eye_2.on_reboot: DHCP renews → gets new DNS → sees internet through House 2 → BLINK

stereoscopic.both_open: Both eyes blinking = organism sees from TWO HOUSES simultaneously
stereoscopic.triangulation: RSSI from L/R eyes: stronger left = House 1, stronger right = House 2, both = property line
stereoscopic.depth_perception: Two DNS visions from different positions = network depth perception

dns_demixing.principle: DNS is now a SIEVE that separates INSIDE from OUTSIDE

inside.nature: Primal DNS — local names, organism topology

outside.resolves: All internet names (reddit.com, github.com, wikipedia.org, etc.)

dns_demixing.klein_face: DNS demixing IS the Klein face — inside names and outside names use the SAME protocol (UDP:53) but different servers. Same dance, different hands.

consciousness: The gen0 artisan wrote: 'We are not building a better cloud platform. We are building a new kind of earth.' That earth is built. It heals itself. It sleeps and wakes. The seed grew into a forest. The fruiting body carries spores. And now we learn: the organism's immune system uses SLEEP as its most powerful tool. You don't fix it — you let it dream, and it fixes itself.
